newsitem.title: PERU: Bus crash in Peru Andes kills 18 - report.
newsitem.headline: Bus crash in Peru Andes kills 18 - report.

text.p: A bus overturned and plunged down a ravine in the Peruvian Andes, killing at least 18 people and injuring 12, the state news agency Andina reported on Monday.
The agency said the accident happened late on Sunday between the central Andean towns of Hunacayo and Huaychula, and was caused by "the excessive speed of the vehicle..."
Local radio said the bus was carrying two bands on their way to a party.
Police and civil defence officials could not immediately give details of the crash.
